o1: A structural constituent of collagen and cuticulin-based cuticle. Involved in cuticle development involved in collagen and cuticulin-based cuticle molting cycle; collagen biosynthetic process. Located in alae of collagen and cuticulin-based cuticle extracellular matrix and annuli extracellular matrix. Is expressed in cuticle; hypodermis; syncytium; vulva; and in male. Used to study photoaging.
